title: Sea Turtles in Madeira: Can You Spot Loggerheads at Sea?
description: See loggerhead sea turtles in Madeira: when they surface, where to look from a small boat and how to watch them without disturbing them. Honest odds too.
heroAlt: A loggerhead sea turtle surfacing to breathe on the blue sea off Madeira
keywords: best time to see turtles Madeira
